# Toolkit Heros

`app/src/main/res/font/toolkit_heros_regular.otf` and `toolkit_heros_bold.otf` are derived from
**TeX Gyre Heros 2.004** (B. Jackowski and J. M. Nowacki, GUST e-foundry), a free Helvetica-like
typeface, used for the clock header.

Changes from the original, made with fontTools:

- subset to Basic Latin, Latin-1 and a few punctuation marks (French text and digits);
- renamed to "Toolkit Heros" (font names and files), as the GUST Font License asks of derived works.

The original fonts and their license: `README-TeX-Gyre-Heros.txt` and `GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt` in
this folder (GUST Font License, an instance of the LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c,
https://www.latex-project.org/lppl.txt).
